ticker_news.title: Not So Fast. Ripple's Legal Woes Aren't Quite Over.
ticker_news.description: The SEC and Ripple have agreed to drop their appeals, ending over four years of legal battles. The court ruling against Ripple's direct institutional sales still stands, but the SEC will keep $50 million of the fine and return the remaining $75 million to Ripple. The outcome is a mixed bag, with Ripple able to focus on its core business but still facing some legal uncertainty.
ticker_news.author: Emma Newbery

ticker_news.title: Should You Buy the Dip in Chainlink Right Now?
ticker_news.description: Chainlink, the leading oracle coin, has a strong competitive moat due to its first-mover advantage and widespread integration. The recent price dip offers an attractive entry point for investors interested in crypto infrastructure.
ticker_news.author: Anders Bylund

SPY.title: US Stocks Likely To Open Lower After The Worst Selloff Since 2020: Tariff Announcement Was '100% Smoot Hawley Disguised As Thoughtful Policy,' Says Expert
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Friday after a broad market selloff on Thursday following the introduction of President Trump's tariffs. Experts criticized the tariffs as a 'Smoot Hawley disguised as thoughtful policy', which caused the market to plummet.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
